proposed_rules.trigger: A root-level sibling node sized exactly to the viewport (e.g. 1280x720) positioned at 0,0, with no text and no clear relation to the surrounding content flow.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a capture artifact (likely a hidden video/lightbox modal or iframe promoted to root by the overlay-detection pass) — exclude from block inventory pending Phase 2 confirmation.
